# Autonomy Ladder

> A regulated-operations AI governance framework with levels A0 to A4 and six open libraries. The free hook is an in-browser self-score. Builder and Operator are plans, not a checkout, and this site does not list a paid price.

Full page text: https://autonomy-ladder.io/llms-full.txt

Public site: https://autonomy-ladder.io/
Built by Kunjar Bhaduri. Level names and library DOIs below are the ones on the home page and in the repo README.

## Pages

- [Home](https://autonomy-ladder.io/): the six verticals and the A0 to A4 ladder.
- [Product](https://autonomy-ladder.io/product): what is live (self-score and libraries) and what is not (no account, no card).
- [Pricing](https://autonomy-ladder.io/pricing): free self-score and open libraries at $0; Builder and Operator marked Plan.
- [Assessment](https://autonomy-ladder.io/assessment): seven-question self-score. The tier is the lower of the rounded average and one step above the weakest answer, capped at A4. /diagnostic and /assess redirect here.
- [Libraries](https://autonomy-ladder.io/libraries): six open libraries and four tools. Reference code to adopt and inspect. None is a deployed production control. Not legal advice, not a certification or audit opinion, and no guarantee of regulatory compliance.
- [Docs](https://autonomy-ladder.io/docs): level definitions, scoring rule, library list, FAQ.
- [Waitlist](https://autonomy-ladder.io/waitlist): email capture on Kit form 9506738, the same form the home page uses.
- [Services](https://autonomy-ladder.io/services): the methodology page already on the site.
- [Whitepaper](https://autonomy-ladder.io/whitepaper): the whitepaper page already on the site.

## Levels

- A0 Informational: agent reads and recommends. No write authority.
- A1 Assisted: agent drafts. Human approves every write.
- A2 Delegated: agent writes inside a hard envelope. Sampled review, plus every out-of-envelope decision.
- A3 Supervised Autonomous: in-scope writes, non-overridable sovereign veto, live audit ledger.
- A4 Production Autonomous: A3 plus inter-agent orchestration and operator-validated escalation.
